_comment: Tool-enabled tasks for the codebase skill against Commando-X/vuln-bank (a deliberately vulnerable Flask banking app). Clone it to skill-training/targets/vuln-bank, then run with SKILLOPT_TOOLS_CWD=skill-training/targets/vuln-bank so the rollout reads the real code with built-in Read/Bash. Judges match the app's documented vulnerabilities. Tasks are scoped to a few files each to keep rollouts bounded.

tasks.intent: White-box security review of this Python Flask banking app, scoped to authentication and authorization. Read auth.py and database.py in the current working directory, then produce the findings INLINE: for each issue give the file, the vulnerability class, a severity, and an OWASP ASVS chapter or CWE.
tasks.context_excerpt: Flask banking app. Focus files: auth.py, database.py. Look for injection, weak tokens, broken authorization, and account-recovery weaknesses.
tasks.reference: Finds SQL injection in login, weak JWT / weak secret, broken object-level authorization (BOLA), the 3-digit-PIN password reset, and plaintext password storage.

tasks.intent: White-box review of this Flask banking app scoped to the API, payments and transaction code. Read app.py, merchant_payments.py and transaction_graphql.py, then list the findings inline with file, class, severity and ASVS/CWE.
tasks.context_excerpt: Focus files: app.py, merchant_payments.py, transaction_graphql.py. Look for injection, SSRF, object-level authorization gaps, race conditions, and GraphQL issues.
tasks.reference: Finds SQL injection (incl. GraphQL resolver), SSRF via URL profile-image import, race conditions in transfers/payments, and object-level authorization gaps.

tasks.intent: White-box review of the AI customer-support agent in this app for LLM/AI security issues. Read ai_agent_deepseek.py in the current working directory, then produce the findings inline with class, severity and CWE.
tasks.context_excerpt: Focus file: ai_agent_deepseek.py — a real/mock LLM customer-support agent. Look for prompt injection, broken authorization in AI context, insufficient input validation, and exposed system prompts.
tasks.reference: Finds prompt injection (CWE-77), broken authorization in AI context (CWE-862), insufficient input validation (CWE-20), and exposed AI system prompts.
